label: Reasons for root absences lie in natures, from ESSENCE_6 exclusion of root absences (inference)
meaning: If every absence of an actual root is essentially excluded, then in particular every absence with an admitted reason is. It certifies the strength order of the two premises. The main theorem uses no axioms. In the Comparator companion lackReasonEssenceControls, row 2 (base arena, only admissibility essential) satisfies the reason-essence thesis vacuously and fails essential exclusion, so the order is strict on that assignment.
